title: Dependent type theory
summary: Dependent types may vary with terms, letting statements and proofs live in one typed language.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared type theory context is fixed.

content.plain: Dependent types may vary with terms, letting statements and proofs live in one typed language.
content.exact: A dependent product Π(x:A).B(x) generalizes functions and universal propositions; a dependent sum Σ(x:A).B(x) packages a witness with data depending on it.
content.example: A vector type Vec(A,n) records its length n in the type.
content.caveat: There are many dependent type theories with different equality, universe, and extensionality rules.
